intent: a long run reports what it is doing, on stderr for a person and as notifications/progress for MCP, without touching the JSON on stdout

steps.caption: BEFORE — the run always knew, and only ever told a log file
NOW — the same phases, on stderr, as they happen
steps.command: node dist/cli/bin.js verify --plan fixture-pricing --vcs local --json 2>/tmp/w-progress.txt >/dev/null; cat /tmp/w-progress.txt

steps.caption: stdout is untouched — still the JSON verdict an agent parses
--quiet asks for silence, and gets it: zero bytes on stderr
steps.command: node dist/cli/bin.js verify --plan fixture-pricing --vcs local --json --quiet 2>/tmp/w-quiet.txt >/dev/null; wc -c < /tmp/w-quiet.txt

steps.caption: MCP forwards the same events as notifications/progress
and the tests that hold it there
